arguments.summary: Fixed the issue where PATCHing an account would change its password even when no password was provided. The problem was that during PATCH operations, the existing hashed password was being included in the payload and then hashed again, breaking authentication. The fix detects when a password value appears to be already hashed (bcrypt format starting with $2b$) and avoids re-hashing it.
